question: Should OpenClaw accept `{ owner }` object records as a supported persisted shape for `plugins.slots.memory` and `plugins.slots.contextEngine` now?
rationale: The canonical RFC was stale-closed, and this PR changes a compatibility-sensitive config/API contract that plugin authors and auth/provider trust paths may rely on.

options.title: Sponsor owner-record slots
options.body: Accept the config direction, then require the branch to normalize all affected core and bundled-plugin readers plus exact-head proof before merge.

options.title: Defer to a fresh RFC
options.body: Keep this PR paused until maintainers reopen or replace the stale owner-record RFC with the desired permanent shape.

options.title: Reject object-form slots for now
options.body: Close this branch and keep slot values string-only until a broader memory-slot architecture decision is made.

recommendation.title: Sponsor owner-record slots
recommendation.body: Accept the config direction, then require the branch to normalize all affected core and bundled-plugin readers plus exact-head proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The multi-kind slot work is the closest merged feature history for slot ownership semantics.
